name: redis-connection-errors
description: Redis connection/timeout errors from Open edX services in mereka-lms namespace.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND (textPayload:"redis.exceptions" OR textPayload:"Error 111 connecting to redis" OR textPayload:"ConnectionError" OR textPayload:"Timeout connecting to server" OR textPayload:"RedisError" OR jsonPayload.message:"redis.exceptions" OR jsonPayload.message:"Error 111 connecting to redis")
